newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Netanyahu wants urgent Arafat meeting - official.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu wants urgent Arafat meeting - official.

text.p: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has asked Palestinian President Yasser Arafat for a meeting as soon as possible because of clashes that have killed at least 50 people, an Israeli official said.

A senior official who flew with Netanyahu to Israel from a European trip which cut short by the violence told reporters traveling on the plane from Germany that Netanyahu had made the request in a phone call to Arafat.
